+\"\"\"Minimal standard-library client for private OpenAI text prompts.\"\"\"
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from typing import Any, TextIO
+
+
+API_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60.0
+
+
+class OpenAIError(RuntimeError):
+    \"\"\"An unsuccessful request to the OpenAI Responses API.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        message: str,
+        *,
+        status_code: int | None = None,
+        error_type: str | None = None,
+        code: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.error_type = error_type
+        self.code = code
+
+
+class OpenAIResponsesClient:
+    \"\"\"Send text prompts to OpenAI without third-party dependencies.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        api_key: str | None = None,
+        *,
+        model: str,
+        timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    ) -> None:
+        resolved_api_key = api_key if api_key is not None else os.getenv(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+        if not resolved_api_key:
+            raise ValueError(\"OPENAI_API_KEY is not set\")
+        if not model or not model.strip():
+            raise ValueError(\"model must be a non-empty string\")
+        if timeout <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(\"timeout must be greater than zero\")
+
+        self._api_key = resolved_api_key
+        self.model = model
+        self.timeout = timeout
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return (
+            f\"{type(self).__name__}(model={self.model"'!r}, "
+            f"timeout={self.timeout!r}, api_key='"'[REDACTED]')\"
+        )
+
+    def create_response(
+        self,
+        prompt: str,
+        *,
+        instructions: str | None = None,
+        timeout: float | None = None,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        \"\"\"Create one response and return the unmodified API JSON object.\"\"\"
+        if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt:
+            raise ValueError(\"prompt must be a non-empty string\")
+        if instructions is not None and not isinstance(instructions, str):
+            raise TypeError(\"instructions must be a string or None\")
+
+        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
+            \"model\": self.model,
+            \"input\": [
+                {
+                    \"role\": \"user\",
+                    \"content\": [{\"type\": \"input_text\", \"text\": prompt}],
+                }
+            ],
+            \"store\": False,
+        }
+        if instructions is not None:
+            payload[\"instructions\"] = instructions
+
+        request_timeout = self.timeout if timeout is None else timeout
+        if request_timeout <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(\"timeout must be greater than zero\")
+
+        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")
+        request = urllib.request.Request(
+            API_URL,
+            data=body,
+            headers={
+                \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self._api_key}\",
+                \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
+                \"Accept\": \"application/json\",
+                \"User-Agent\": \"openai-responses-stdlib/1.0\",
+            },
+            method=\"POST\",
+        )
+
+        try:
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=request_timeout) as response:
+                response_body = response.read()
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+            raise self._http_error(error) from None
+        except urllib.error.URLError as error:
+            reason = error.reason
+            raise OpenAIError(f\"could not reach the OpenAI API: {reason}\") from None
+
+        try:
+            result = json.loads(response_body.decode(\"utf-8\"))
+        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+            raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI returned invalid JSON\") from error
+        if not isinstance(result, dict):
+            raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI returned an unexpected JSON value\")
+        return result
+
+    def send_prompt(
+        self,
+        prompt: str,
+        *,
+        instructions: str | None = None,
+        timeout: float | None = None,
+    ) -> str:
+        \"\"\"Send one text prompt and return the response's text.\"\"\"
+        return extract_text(
+            self.create_response(
+                prompt,
+                instructions=instructions,
+                timeout=timeout,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def send(
+        self,
+        prompt: str,
+        *,
+        instructions: str | None = None,
+        timeout: float | None = None,
+    ) -> str:
+        \"\"\"Alias for :meth:"'`send_prompt`."""
+        return self.send_prompt(prompt, instructions=instructions, timeout=timeout)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _http_error(error: urllib.error.HTTPError) -> OpenAIError:
+        try:
+            body = json.loads(error.read().decode("utf-8"))
+        except (AttributeError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+            body = None
+
+        details = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
+        if not isinstance(details, dict):
+            details = {}
+
+        message = details.get("message") or f"OpenAI API request failed ({error.code})"
+        error_type = details.get("type")
+        code = details.get("code")
+        return OpenAIError(
+            str(message),
+            status_code=error.code,
+            error_type=str(error_type) if error_type is not None else None,
+            code=str(code) if code is not None else None,
+        )
+
+
+def extract_text(response: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Extract textual output from a Responses API JSON object."""
+    output_text = response.get("output_text")
+    if isinstance(output_text, str):
+        return output_text
+
+    output = response.get("output")
+    if not isinstance(output, list):
+        return ""
+
+    text_parts: list[str] = []
+    for item in output:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "message":
+            continue
+        content = item.get("content")
+        if not isinstance(content, list):
+            continue
+        for part in content:
+            if not isinstance(part, dict):
+                continue
+            part_type = part.get("type")
+            if part_type == "output_text" and isinstance(part.get("text"), str):
+                text_parts.append(part["text"])
+            elif part_type == "refusal" and isinstance(part.get("refusal"), str):
+                text_parts.append(part["refusal"])
+    return "".join(text_parts)
+
+
+def send_prompt(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: str,
+    api_key: str | None = None,
+    instructions: str | None = None,
+    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+) -> str:
+    """Send one private text prompt using the OpenAI Responses API."""
+    client = OpenAIResponsesClient(api_key, model=model, timeout=timeout)
+    return client.send_prompt(prompt, instructions=instructions)
+
+
+def _read_optional_file(path: str | None, stream: TextIO) -> str | None:
+    if path is None:
+        return None
+    if path == "-":
+        return stream.read()
+    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
+        return file.read()
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description=(
+            "Read a private prompt from stdin and print text from the "
+            "OpenAI Responses API."
+        )
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--model",
+        default=os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL"),
+        help="model name (defaults to OPENAI_MODEL)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--instructions-file",
+        help="read optional instructions from a UTF-8 file, or '"'-' for stdin\",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        \"--timeout\",
+        type=float,
+        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+        help=\"request timeout in seconds\",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    if not args.model:
+        parser.error(\"--model or OPENAI_MODEL is required\")
+    if args.instructions_file == \"-\" and sys.stdin.isatty():
+        parser.error(\"--instructions-file - cannot read from a terminal\")
+
+    try:
+        prompt = sys.stdin.read()
+        instructions = _read_optional_file(args.instructions_file, sys.stdin)
+        client = OpenAIResponsesClient(
+            model=args.model,
+            timeout=args.timeout,
+        )
+        text = client.send_prompt(prompt, instructions=instructions)
+    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError, OpenAIError) as error:
+        print(f\"error: {error}\", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    sys.stdout.write(text)
+    if text and not text.endswith(\"\\n\"):
+        sys.stdout.write(\"\\n\")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
